scope: Migration executor and shared-storage adapter review; supplements existing regressions, fuzz and sanitizers.
findings: NativeOperation joins dispatch workers before scoped borrows return and transfers cancellation through mutex-owned state.
Suite adapter retains sealed read-only storage rather than a pointer or pixel array; concurrent encoders join before owner release.
Decoded storage is reused only through the original reserved destination after pre-write cancellation; a second reservation is not substituted.
Unknown SwiftJXL allocation counters remain unknown; independent heap telemetry checks the handoff.
limits: Finite source-path review, not an exhaustive audit of all native kernels.
